name: YJ MGC3 Beta 3x3 (Limited Edition)
description: The YJ MGC Beta 3x3 (Limited Edition) is a collector’s release of the popular MGC Beta 3x3, available in two stunning transparent colors: green and pink. It features the signature MGC Beta design and feel, but is simply a cool collector’s item without stickers. We recommend applying this sticker set to improve color contrast and make the cube suitable for actual solving.
